body:
Hi Suresh, with your Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149 getting 22 positive reviews and views up 5%, let's launch the Corporate Bulk Thali Package for Indiranagar offices. It will package your popular ₹149 Thali for bulk corporate bookings.

Reply YES to activate this draft on your profile.
rationale: The message directly answers the merchant's last question by proposing a concrete plan for the corporate bulk thali package. It uses the existing ₹149 Thali price, positive review count, and 5% views growth to justify the launch with operator-to-operator speed.

body:
Hi Padma! With Zen Yoga Studio's views up 10% and calls up 15% this week, let's launch your Kids Yoga Summer Camp. I have the draft ready, highlighting your highly-rated small classes and top instructors to capture this rising demand.

Reply YES to preview the draft and launch it!
rationale: I addressed the merchant by name and used her active planning intent for a kids yoga summer camp. I leveraged her positive 7-day performance trends (views up 10%, calls up 15%) and positive review themes (small classes, instructor quality) to create momentum, ending with a single, clear yes/no CTA to preview the draft.

body: Hi Aditya, this is a reminder from Karim's Salon in Alambagh for your appointment tomorrow. We look forward to welcoming you!
rationale: The message directly addresses the customer Aditya, identifying the business as Karim's Salon in Alambagh, and reminds them of their appointment tomorrow in a brief, operational tone under 200 characters.

body: Hi Riya, yeh reminder hai aapke kal ke appointment ke liye Beauty Lounge by Renu, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow par. See you tomorrow!
rationale: Used customer name Riya, business name Beauty Lounge by Renu, and location Gomti Nagar, Lucknow to send a warm, practical reminder in Hindi-English code-mix as preferred by the customer.

body: Ramesh ji, Malviya Nagar mein Apollo Health Plus Pharmacy ki demand badh rahi hai. Last 7 days mein aapke views 6% aur calls 8% badhe hain. Is trend ka fayda uthane ke liye, kya hum aapka 'Free Home Delivery' offer promote karein? Reply YES to activate.
rationale: Used the merchant's name, location, and 7-day positive performance trends (views up 6%, calls up 8%) to establish local momentum, then offered to promote their existing 'Free Home Delivery' offer with a clear yes/no CTA.

body: Dr. Meera, clinic views are up 18%! To better serve your 124 high-risk adult patients, kya aap upcoming CDE opportunities join karke credits earn karna chahenge? Reply to get more details about the event.
rationale: Addressed the merchant as Dr. Meera to match the peer-clinical dentist tone, using her 18% views growth and 124 high-risk adult patients to establish clinical relevance. Offered CDE credit opportunities with an open-ended CTA to get event details, using a natural Hindi-English code-mix.

body: Namaste Mr. Sharma! Apollo Health Plus Pharmacy, Malviya Nagar se. Aapki Metformin & Atorvastatin medicines ka refill due hai. Senior Citizens ke liye 15% OFF aur >₹499 par free home delivery available hai. Kya hum aapki morning delivery schedule karein?
rationale: The message is written in the customer's preferred Hinglish language, addressing them by name and identifying the pharmacy. It references their specific chronic medications due for refill, highlights relevant active offers (Senior Citizen discount and free delivery), and ends with an open-ended question about their preferred morning delivery slot.

body: Hello Vivaan, Dr. Sameer from Bright Smile Dental, Indiranagar here. It has been some time since your last visit on 2026-04-01. Since you've completed 5 visits with us, we wanted to check in. When would be a good time for your next routine checkup?
rationale: The message is personalized using the customer's name, last visit date, and total visits to establish continuity. It is sent from Dr. Sameer at Bright Smile Dental to maintain the peer-clinical/professional tone and ends with an open-ended question to encourage a booking.

body: Dr. Meera, Lajpat Nagar mein new competition is active. While your views are up 18%, your CTR is 2.1%, which is below the 3.0% peer median. To strengthen your positioning, should we promote your Dental Cleaning @ ₹299 offer? Reply YES to approve.
rationale: Addressed the dentist as 'Dr. Meera' and used her location to alert her to new competition. Leveraged her 18% views growth and below-median 2.1% CTR to create urgency, offering to promote her active ₹299 dental cleaning offer as a counter-measure.

body: Hi Suresh, a new competitor opened in Indiranagar. Mylari Cafe views are up 5% with a 3.2% CTR (above the 2.5% median). Let's protect your momentum by boosting your ₹149 Weekday Lunch Thali offer. Reply YES to activate.
rationale: Alerted the merchant to a new competitor in Indiranagar using operator-to-operator speed. Leveraged positive performance metrics (views up 5%, CTR above median) to motivate protecting their momentum by boosting their active ₹149 Thali offer.

body: Hi Lakshmi! Studio11 views are up 14% this week. To tailor your next campaign, what service is in highest demand at Kapra right now—haircuts or hair spa?
rationale: Used the owner's name, business name, and location for personalization. Incorporated the 14% views growth metric to show momentum and asked an open-ended question about their active offers to tailor future campaigns.

body: Hi Suresh, views for Mylari South Indian Cafe are up 5%! Is your Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149 still the top crowd-puller, or is another dish trending?
rationale: I addressed the owner by name, referenced their 5% increase in weekly views to show momentum, and asked an open-ended question about their active ₹149 Thali offer to understand their current demand.

body: Hi Rashmi, we miss you at PowerHouse Fitness! You've done 22 visits with us. Ready to restart your weekday evening routine? We have 3 FREE Trial Classes for you. Reply YES to book your first session!
rationale: This message directly addresses the customer by name, references her 22 past visits and preferred weekday evening slot to build familiarity, and offers the active 3 FREE Trial Classes promotion with a clear Yes/No CTA.

body: Hi Reyansh, Dr. Asha here from Asha Dental Care, Sector 17. We missed you since your last visit on 1st April 2026. To keep your dental health on track, would you like to schedule your routine check-up? Reply YES to book an appointment this week.
rationale: This message uses the customer's name, last visit date, and the doctor's name to create a highly personalized, warm reminder for a routine check-up, ending with a clear yes/no CTA.

body: Hello Reyansh ji, Daily Care Medicos, Alambagh se. Aapki last visit 1st April ko thi. Humne aapko 12 visits me serve kiya hai. Kya aapko medicines ya healthcare essentials refill karne hain? Reply YES to order.
rationale: This message uses the customer's name, last visit date, and total visits to create a personalized, trustworthy pharmacy re-engagement message in their preferred Hindi-English mix, ending with a clear yes/no CTA.

body: Hi Anjali, weekly calls for Glamour Lounge Spa & Salon are down 30% and views dropped 12% in Aundh. How can we help you get your salon's traffic back up?
rationale: This message re-engages the dormant merchant by highlighting a recent drop in weekly calls and views, providing a warm, practical salon-category tone and ending with a low-friction open-ended question.

body: Hi Anand, noticing 2189 views for Chai Point Cafe recently. What is your top focus this week?
rationale: Used Anand's name, Chai Point Cafe, and recent 30d views (2189) from facts to create a light-touch, low-pressure re-engagement question.

body: Hi Lakshmi, Studio11's views are up 14% in Kapra! With Diwali coming, let's capture early bookings for your 1,150 YTD customers. Reply YES to preview an early festive package draft.
rationale: Used the owner's name, business name, and location for warm personalization. Leveraged the 14% views trend and 1,150 YTD customers to show momentum, prompting early Diwali package creation with a clear binary CTA.

body:
Hi Pooja, with the festive season near, let's boost Bend & Burn's views in Koramangala (down 7% this week). Let's launch an early-bird festive package to engage your 387 YTD customers and improve your 4.2% CTR.

Reply YES to preview the draft campaign.
rationale: Addressed the gym owner Pooja by name, motivating her to reverse the 7% drop in weekly views and improve her 4.2% CTR by launching an early-bird festive package for her 387 YTD customers in Koramangala. Ended with a clear binary CTA.

body: Hi Vikas, Sunrise Medicos in Gomti Nagar got 720 profile views and 14 calls in 30 days. Verifying your Google Business Profile helps patients find you faster. Reply YES to guide through verification.
rationale: Used merchant name Vikas, business name Sunrise Medicos, location Gomti Nagar, and recent performance facts (720 views, 14 calls) to highlight the benefit of verifying the unverified Google profile with a clear YES CTA.

body:
Suresh ji, aaj Delhi mein DC vs MI match hai! Sant Nagar mein delivery surge expected hai. Aapke Google views 8% up hain, par CTR 2.0% hai. Match-day combo offer live karke orders badhein?

Reply YES to push the match combo offer.
rationale: Addressed the merchant by name and used the local Delhi match context to create urgency. Weaved in the 8% views growth and 2.0% CTR to highlight the opportunity to capture more traffic with a single-tap CTA.

body: Hi Suresh! Mylari South Indian Cafe is just 5 reviews away from the 150-review milestone, driving 12,400 Google views this month. Reply YES to post a celebration update on your Google Profile and keep the momentum going!
rationale: This message celebrates the milestone of being 5 reviews away from 150, leveraging the 12,400 Google views to show momentum. It uses a direct, low-friction yes/no CTA to publish an update.

body: Mukesh ji, Pizza Spot has reached 889 unique customers YTD! Aapke Google views bhi 14% up hain. Let's share this milestone on your Google Profile to keep the momentum going. Reply YES to post this update.
rationale: Celebrated the milestone of 889 unique customers YTD and reinforced momentum with the 14% 7-day views increase. Used a natural Hinglish tone for Mukesh and provided a single binary CTA to post the update.

body: Dr. Bharat, weekly calls for Bharat Dental Care are down 50% and views dropped 22%. Your CTR of 1.8% is below the peer median of 3.0%. To recover this momentum, we can launch a campaign to re-engage your 95 lapsed patients. Reply YES to activate.
rationale: Addressed the merchant as 'Dr. Bharat' to match the peer-clinical dentist tone. Used the 50% call drop, 22% view drop, and below-average CTR to establish a clear performance dip, then offered a concrete recovery step targeting their 95 lapsed patients with a single binary CTA.

body: Hi Sushma ji! The Beauty Bar ka Pro plan expire ho gaya hai. Aapka CTR 5.8% hai (peer median 4.0% se upar) aur views 8% badhe hain. Is momentum ko khone se bachayein. Kya hum Pro plan renew karein? Reply YES to renew.
rationale: Alerted the merchant to the expired Pro plan as a risk to their current positive momentum (views up 8% and CTR at 5.8%, which is above the 4.0% peer median). Used a warm, practical Hinglish tone suitable for a salon owner.

body: Hi Padma, Zen Yoga Studio is on a roll! Calls are up 15% this week, and your 6.2% CTR is beating the 4.5% peer average. Let's keep this momentum going. Reply YES to pin your 'First Month @ ₹499' offer to the top of your profile.
rationale: Celebrated the 15% call spike and 6.2% CTR (beating peer median) to show momentum, then offered a clear binary CTA to pin their top active offer.

body: Vikas ji, Sunrise Medicos par customer interest badh raha hai! Last 7 days mein calls 5% aur views 2% up hain. Aapka CTR 4.1% hai, jo peer median (3.8%) se behtar hai. Is momentum ko badhane ke liye, kya aap ek naya offer active karenge? Reply YES to activate.
rationale: Used the merchant's name, business name, and positive 7-day trends (calls up 5%, views up 2%, CTR 4.1% vs 3.8% peer median) to build trust and momentum. Offered a clear binary CTA to activate an offer to capitalize on this traffic, matching the pharmacy's precise tone.

body: Hi Priya, it's Dr. Meera from Dr. Meera's Dental Clinic. Your 6-month dental cleaning is due. Let's keep that smile healthy! Would you like to book Wed 5 Nov, 6pm or Thu 6 Nov, 5pm? Reply YES to confirm your slot.
rationale: Used facts identifying Dr. Meera's Dental Clinic, customer Priya, service due (6-month cleaning), and available slots to craft a warm, professional recall reminder with a clear yes_no booking CTA.

body: Hi Diya! We've missed your energy at Zen Yoga Studio, Mylapore. It's been a while since your last session on April 1st. Ready to step back onto the mat? Can we book you for Wednesday 7 AM or Saturday 9 AM? Reply YES to confirm. - Padma
rationale: This message uses the customer's name, last visit date, and business details to create a warm, personalized recall. It offers specific time slots with a clear yes/no CTA to make booking frictionless.

body: Dr. Meera, note this urgent DCI circular from Nov 4: revised radiograph dose limits take effect Dec 15, 2026. Area clinics are updating SOPs this week to avoid penalties. Reply YES to audit your X-ray setup and update SOPs now.
rationale: Used facts [f1], [f18], [f19], [f20], [f21], and [f22] to alert Dr. Meera about the DCI radiograph compliance deadline with a peer-clinical tone and a single binary CTA to audit her setup.
